articles.title: A Birthday to Remember: Heliovaara and Patten Storm into French Open Final
articles.summary: On his 37th birthday, Harri Heliovaara and partner Henry Patten cruised into the French Open doubles final without dropping a set all tournament. A win would make Patten the first British man to claim the title in the Open era.

articles.title: Prints with a Purpose: 'America Today' Exhibition Amplifies Artists' Voices
articles.summary: At The Print Center in Philadelphia, 'America Today: Voices in Contemporary Print' showcases works from six community-focused print shops. The exhibition, running through July 25, tackles civil rights, social justice, and cultural heritage through diverse printmaking styles.

articles.title: From Hawkins to a Love Triangle: Sadie Sink to Star in FX's 'The Marriage Plot'
articles.summary: Sadie Sink will lead a limited series adaptation of Jeffrey Eugenides' novel 'The Marriage Plot' for FX and Hulu. Written by Will Arbery and directed by Hiro Murai, the show follows three college graduates navigating a complicated love triangle and the pressures of adulthood.
